heightmap.note: height_cm = (v - 32768) / 128 * zScalePercent; vertex i spans x = -S/2 + i*S/(res-1)

masks.note: pixel centres; uv (0,0) = web (-S/2,-S/2); R forest G veg B ice A water | R slope G firn B pad

flow.note: 8-bit grey, Masks pixel-centre convention; 255*log(1+t)/log(1+T), t = droplet paths per unit rain crossing the pixel (11 m + 5.5 m passes), T = 99.9th percentile. High on gully floors, valley bottoms and fans.

lakes2Note: Tools/WorldBake/lakes.py: lakes of the final heightmap (priority flood). Cells of the res grid; x = -S/2 + (i0+i)*cell; rle = dry/wet runs over w*h, row-major, dry first.
